methodology: The update tests valuation eligibility, not a new house price target. No covered candidate passes the joint current-price, actual-or-reconciled earnings, cash-conversion and independent-anchor gates. Broker targets and mathematical upside are retained only as external reference points in broker_street_consensus_20260811.json.

field_policy.not_published: A field value of not_published is a deliberate no-target disposition, not a missing value or a zero price.
field_policy.weights: fundamental_weight, market_weight and broker_weight are house-target blend weights. They are all zero because this case publishes no house target; external_anchor_weight_cap remains a separate evidence cap.
field_policy.scenarios: bear, base and bull are not_published when no independent price scenario is defensible.
